name: ShipmentBookingDesk
tagline: From booking request to collected pickup – reply SLA, 11 booking checks, quote-to-booking pricing and depot capacity in one Power Apps component.
description: A complete customer-service booking desk for carriers, 3PLs and forwarders. Requests from the customer portal, email, EDI 204, API or phone are answered within a reply SLA, checked by an 11-point validation engine (contact, addresses, cut-off, window, transit, load vs service, dangerous goods, reefer temperature, quote validity, depot capacity, duplicates), converted from quotes with fuel surcharge and accessorials, confirmed with a ready-to-send message and scheduled against the daily pickup capacity of each depot – in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: Reply SLA countdown and Act now list
11 booking checks with fail / warn and next step
Same-day cut-off, pickup hours and minimum window
Service limits with LTL → FTL suggestion
Dangerous goods UN-number and reefer set-point checks
Quote → booking with fuel surcharge and accessorial charges, price locked on confirm
Depot zones by postcode and daily pickup capacity with supervisor override
Offer another day / move pickup to the next free day
Schedule, picked up, pickup failed, late cancellation fee
Bulk confirm / info / schedule / assign / cancel
Undo, history, CSV and JSON outputs
